title: Dragonfly Energy Holdings Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Dragonfly Energy Holdings Corp. (DFLI) filed an 8-K on April 23, 2026, disclosing receipt of a patent allowance from the Japan Patent Office for powderized solid-state electrolyte and electroactive materials technology related to its solid-state battery and dry electrode manufacturing platform.
key_points: Dragonfly Energy Holdings Corp. (ticker: DFLI) trades on Nasdaq Capital Market as an emerging growth company
The company received its first patent application allowance in Japan for solid-state battery electrolyte technology
The patent covers powderized solid-state electrolyte and electroactive materials for scalable, solvent-free electrode production
The technology aims to improve safety, energy density, and manufacturing efficiency
The filing was signed by CEO Denis Phares on April 23, 2026
